issues: 没有导出时长常量，工作台按 default 渲 150f，比镜头本意 145f 多出 5f
终端窗是灰阶占位：窗控三个灰点、标题栏一根灰条、#1e1e1c 平底配一层粗阴影，没有材质
终端里只有一行路径和一行命令，下面大半块是空的黑底
2f/字符机械匀速，光标打字时也在闪，节奏像加载动画
回车后切到 dashboard 就停了，命令敲下去之后什么结果都没有，后面 77f 是死帧
changes: 导出 TERMINAL_TYPEWRITER_DURATION = 145，保留 f58 回车、f58–64 急推 1→3.2、f64 硬切、1.06→1 回稳的节拍
终端重做成出版级窗口：纵向渐变机身 + 白色 7% 发丝边 + 顶部内高光 + 悬浮软阴影，三色窗控略降饱和，标题栏居中写窗口名
补上两条带 ✓ 的历史命令和路径 / 分支行作上下文，压暗成纹理；窗高收到 580，内容铺满不留空底
打字改成逐字 1–4f 的确定性间隔（均值仍 2f，首尾帧不变，新词首字前顿一拍），光标打字中常亮、空闲时才方波闪；回车帧补一行 ▲ Deploying 输出，急推末 3f 加 blur
切到新版 dashboard 后，f80 右下角浮起一枚 "Deployed to production" 提示（snappy 12f，阴影随落定收紧），给引信一个结果
issuesEn: No exported duration constant: the workbench rendered the 150f default, 5f longer than the intended 145f
The terminal was grayscale placeholder art: three gray window dots, a gray bar for the title, a flat #1e1e1c body and one heavy drop shadow, with no sense of material
The terminal held only a path line and a command line, leaving most of the window as empty black
Typing ran at a mechanical 2f per character with the cursor blinking even mid-typing, which read like a loading animation
After Enter the shot cut to the dashboard and stopped: the command produced no visible result, and the last 77f were a dead frame
changesEn: Exported TERMINAL_TYPEWRITER_DURATION = 145, keeping the beats: Enter at f58, the 1→3.2 push over f58–64, the hard cut at f64 and the 1.06→1 settle

Rebuilt the terminal as a publication-grade window: vertical-gradient body, 7% white hairline border, top inner highlight and a soft floating shadow; slightly desaturated traffic lights and a centered window title in the title bar
Added two history commands with ✓ results plus a path / branch line as context, dimmed to texture; the window is now 580px tall, so the content fills it without an empty bottom

Typing now uses deterministic 1–4f gaps per character (still averaging 2f, same first and last frames, with a beat of hesitation before each new word); the cursor stays solid while typing and blinks only when idle; Enter prints a ▲ Deploying output line, and the push blurs over its last 3f
After the cut to the new dashboard, a "Deployed to production" toast rises in at the bottom right at f80 (12f snappy, shadow tightening as it settles), so the command has a visible result
